Overview

Marseille is a city in Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur with a population of 873,000. France’s oldest city and largest Mediterranean port, known for its vibrant multicultural atmosphere and stunning calanques. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
